summary: Iteration 18 — Straddle System now shares Hybrid's Smart Trailing TP. Wrote & ran /app/backend/tests/test_straddle_trailing.py (5 tests). Found & fixed one CRITICAL backend bug: in _open_position (server.py L381) the condition `if tp_price is None OR sl_price is None` overwrote the caller-supplied tp_price=None with the fixed tpPct, so BOTH straddle- and hybrid-source positions were still getting a fixed TP (never routed through _update_trailing). Changed OR → AND so straddle/hybrid callers keep tp_price=None and get routed to smart trailing. After the fix: all 5 new tests + 22 existing regression tests (test_straddle.py + test_hybrid_trailing.py) PASS. Frontend BotPanel verified via Playwright: old bot-straddle-tp / bot-straddle-sl fields are GONE; only bot-straddle-entry remains editable; bot-straddle-trailing-summary shows 'Exits · Smart Trailing TP' text + reference to Hybrid panel; bot-straddle-trailing-values renders Init SL / Secure / BE+ / Step / Callback / Trail with the live shared trail* config values.

rca of the issue: Root cause of the initial straddle-trailing failure: in server.py _open_position the guard `if tp_price is None or sl_price is None: <set both to fixed tpPct/slPct>` was written for the signal-driven code path (which passes neither), but the newly-added straddle & hybrid callers pass tp_price=None + a concrete sl_price. Because the guard is OR, the None tp_price triggered the block and BOTH values were overwritten to the fixed defaults, so the position was created with a fixed tpPrice and process_bot's `if _trail and pos.get('tpPrice') is None: _update_trailing(...)` branch was never entered. Fix: change OR → AND so defaults only fire when neither was supplied. Reproduction: enable straddle in SIM with straddleEntryPct=1e-6, feed a /api/bot/signal, then GET /api/bot/status — before fix openPositions[0].tpPrice was ~entry*1.02 (fixed +2% tpPct); after fix it is null.
